prompt: From: hr@brightco.com / To: all-staff@brightco.com / Subject: Updated Remote Work Policy / Starting October 1, employees may work remotely up to three days per week. Managers must approve schedules in advance. Core hours of 10 a.m. to 3 p.m. still apply. / What is the maximum number of remote days allowed per week?
explanation: Employees may work remotely up to three days per week.

prompt: NOTICE: The parking garage will be closed for maintenance this Saturday and Sunday. Use street parking or the public lot on Maple Avenue. Validation stickers will be provided at the front desk on Monday. / When will the garage be closed?
explanation: Closed Saturday and Sunday (this weekend).

prompt: City Express Bus Schedule / Departs Central Station: 8:00, 10:30, 13:00, 16:45 / Arrives Airport: approx. 55 minutes later / Fare: $12 one-way / $20 round-trip / How long does the trip to the airport take?
explanation: Arrival is approximately 55 minutes later.

prompt: Harbor Bistro — Tonight's Specials / • Seared tuna with mango salsa — $24 / • Vegetarian pasta primavera — $18 / • Chocolate lava cake — $9 / Reservations recommended after 6 p.m. / Which dish costs the least among the specials?
explanation: Chocolate lava cake is $9, the lowest price.

prompt: Agenda — Product Review Meeting (Sept 12) / 1. Welcome (5 min) / 2. Sales update — Linda (15 min) / 3. Prototype demo — Engineering (20 min) / 4. Open discussion (15 min) / Location: Room 4B / Who will present the sales update?
explanation: Linda presents the sales update.

prompt: Dear Ms. Park, / Thank you for your order #45821. Your package shipped today via overnight courier and should arrive by 5 p.m. tomorrow. Tracking: ZX998877. / Best regards, / Customer Service / When should the package arrive?
explanation: It should arrive by 5 p.m. tomorrow.

prompt: Memo: Please submit all travel expense claims within 14 days of returning from a trip. Claims submitted later may not be reimbursed. Use Form T-12 and attach original receipts. / What form is required for expense claims?
explanation: Use Form T-12 with original receipts.

prompt: Grandview Hotel / Check-in: 3:00 p.m. | Check-out: 11:00 a.m. / Early check-in available for $25 after 12:00 p.m. / Late check-out until 2:00 p.m. for $40. / How much is early check-in after noon?
explanation: Early check-in after 12:00 p.m. costs $25.

prompt: Green Leaf Cafe is hiring part-time baristas. Shifts available weekday mornings. Experience preferred but not required. Apply in person between 2 and 4 p.m. weekdays. / When can applicants apply in person?
explanation: Apply in person between 2 and 4 p.m. on weekdays.

prompt: Due to a scheduling conflict, tomorrow's budget meeting has been moved from 9:00 a.m. to 2:30 p.m. The location remains Conference Room A. Please update your calendars. / What changed about the meeting?
explanation: The time changed from 9:00 a.m. to 2:30 p.m.

prompt: Hi team, / I've attached Q3 sales charts. Please review slides 4–7 before Friday's call. Focus on the regional comparison and note any anomalies. / Thanks, Jordan / What should the team focus on?
explanation: Focus on the regional comparison and anomalies.

prompt: Safety Reminder: All visitors must sign in at reception and wear a guest badge. Unescorted visitors are not permitted in the lab area after 6 p.m. / Where must visitors sign in?
explanation: Visitors must sign in at reception.

prompt: Passport Renewal Tips / • Apply at least 8 weeks before travel / • Bring a passport photo taken within 6 months / • Fee: $110 standard / $170 expedited / How far in advance should one apply?
explanation: Apply at least 8 weeks before travel.

prompt: Loyalty Card Offer: Buy 9 coffees, get the 10th free. Card must be stamped at purchase. Offer expires December 31. Not valid with other discounts. / When does the offer expire?
explanation: The offer expires December 31.

prompt: Webinar: Improving Customer Retention / Date: Sept 20 | Time: 11:00 a.m.–12:00 p.m. EST / Speaker: Dr. Anita Rao / Register at learn.brightco.com by Sept 18. Seats limited to 200. / What is the registration deadline?
explanation: Register by September 18.

prompt: Dear Supplier, / Invoice #902 was overcharged by $150. Please issue a credit note and confirm by email. Our PO number is PO-3310. / Regards, Procurement / What does Procurement request?
explanation: They ask for a credit note for the overcharge.

prompt: The company picnic will be held at Riverside Park on September 28 from noon to 4 p.m. Families are welcome. Free parking is available in Lot C. RSVP by September 20. / Where is free parking?
explanation: Free parking is in Lot C.

prompt: Train Ticket Conditions / • Tickets are non-refundable but can be exchanged once for a $15 fee / • Arrive 20 minutes before departure / • Valid photo ID required for reserved seats / How many times can a ticket be exchanged?
explanation: Tickets can be exchanged once for a $15 fee.

prompt: Sunset Grill now offers online ordering for pickup. Orders placed before 11:30 a.m. will be ready by noon. Minimum order: $15. Delivery is not available. / What service is NOT available?
explanation: Delivery is not available.

prompt: Action Items from Aug 30 Meeting / • Maya: finalize vendor list by Sept 5 / • Ken: draft budget by Sept 8 / • All: review draft proposal by Sept 10 / Whose deadline is September 8?
explanation: Ken should draft the budget by Sept 8.

prompt: Subject: Interview Confirmation / Dear Mr. Lee, / Your interview is scheduled for Thursday at 10:15 a.m. with Ms. Gomez in Suite 210. Please bring two copies of your resume. / Where is the interview?
explanation: The interview is in Suite 210.

prompt: IT Alert: Password reset required every 90 days. Passwords must be at least 12 characters and include a number and symbol. Shared passwords are prohibited. / What is the minimum password length?
explanation: Passwords must be at least 12 characters.

prompt: Airport Shuttle from Downtown Hotel / Departs: every hour on the hour from 5 a.m. to 10 p.m. / Travel time: 35–50 minutes depending on traffic / Complimentary for hotel guests; $8 for walk-ins / How much do hotel guests pay?
explanation: Complimentary (free) for hotel guests.

prompt: All-you-can-eat lunch buffet: $19.95 weekdays / $24.95 weekends. Children under 10: half price. Soft drinks included. Desserts extra. / What is included in the buffet price?
explanation: Soft drinks are included; desserts are extra.

prompt: Please join our monthly town hall via video link. The CEO will discuss Q4 priorities. Questions may be submitted in the chat or emailed beforehand to townhall@brightco.com. / How can employees ask questions?
explanation: Questions via chat or email beforehand.

prompt: Hi Alex, / Could you reschedule our 3 p.m. call to 4:30? I have an unexpected client visit. If that doesn't work, Thursday morning is fine. / Thanks, Priya / What is Priya's preferred new time today?
explanation: She asks to move to 4:30; Thursday is the backup.

prompt: Lost & Found: A black umbrella and a silver USB drive were found in Meeting Room 3 yesterday. Please claim at Facilities Desk with a description of the items. / Where should items be claimed?
explanation: Claim at the Facilities Desk.

prompt: Museum Admission / Adults: $18 | Students: $12 | Seniors (65+): $10 | Under 5: free / Closed Mondays. Last entry 30 minutes before closing at 6 p.m. / What is the student ticket price?
explanation: Students pay $12.

prompt: Catering Menu — Office Lunch Boxes / Sandwich combo: $11 | Salad box: $10 | Hot meal: $14 / Orders of 20+ receive 10% off. Place orders 24 hours in advance. / What discount applies to 20+ orders?
explanation: Orders of 20+ get 10% off.

prompt: The design review originally planned for Friday has been canceled. A shorter check-in will be held Monday at 9 a.m. instead. No need to prepare full mockups. / What replaced the Friday review?
explanation: A shorter Monday 9 a.m. check-in replaces it.

prompt: Dear Customer, / Your warranty for laptop SN-77821 expires on November 15. Extended coverage can be purchased until that date for $89 per year. / Support Team / Until when can extended coverage be bought?
explanation: Extended coverage can be purchased until November 15.

prompt: Building hours: Monday–Friday 7 a.m.–8 p.m. Weekends: access by keycard for authorized staff only. Loading dock closes at 5 p.m. daily. / Who may enter on weekends?
explanation: Weekend access is for authorized staff with keycard.

prompt: Flight Change Notice / Original: Flight AA210, Sept 9, 2:40 p.m. / New: Flight AA218, Sept 9, 5:10 p.m. / Seat: 14C retained. Meal voucher emailed. / What stayed the same?
explanation: Still September 9; time and flight number changed.

prompt: Happy Hour: 4–6 p.m. weekdays. Appetizers half price. Soft drinks $2. Not available on holidays. Dine-in only. / Which is true about Happy Hour?
explanation: Weekdays 4–6 p.m., dine-in only, not on holidays.

prompt: Team offsite will be at Lakeside Conference Center on Oct 3–4. Transportation vans leave the office at 8:15 a.m. Bring business casual attire and a laptop. / What time do vans leave?
explanation: Vans leave at 8:15 a.m.

prompt: Please find attached the signed NDA. Kindly countersign and return a scanned copy within three business days so we can share project materials. / What must the recipient do within three business days?
explanation: Countersign and return a scanned copy.

prompt: Flu shots will be offered free in the lobby on Sept 15 from 9 a.m. to 1 p.m. Bring your employee ID. Dependents are not covered this year. / Who can receive a free flu shot?
explanation: Employees should bring ID; dependents not covered.

prompt: Car Rental Agreement Summary / • Unlimited mileage within the state / • Out-of-state travel requires prior approval / • Refuel to full before return or pay $6/gallon service fee / What requires prior approval?
explanation: Out-of-state travel needs prior approval.

prompt: The bakery will temporarily close Sept 8–10 for kitchen renovations. Online pre-orders resume Sept 11. Fresh bread returns Sept 12. / When does fresh bread return?
explanation: Fresh bread returns September 12.

prompt: Quarterly performance reviews begin next week. Employees should complete self-assessments in the HR portal by Friday. Manager meetings will be scheduled afterward. / What is due by Friday?
explanation: Self-assessments are due by Friday.
